decisions.mark: states that the post is written to the local database before it is sent, and on failure is kept and marked `failed: true`
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `createPost` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts:74`) saves the post locally first, under a pending ID (`pending_post_id`), so it shows in the UI. ... **Any other error**: the post is rewritten with `props.failed = true` and saved. | WHY: The answer states the post is saved locally before the send, and that on non-server-error failure it is kept and marked `failed = true`. || QUOTE: `createPost` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts:74`) saves the post locally first, under a pending ID (`pending_post_id`), so it shows in the UI. decisions.mark: names the server errors for which the failed post is removed instead of kept — deleted root post, read-only town square, plugin-dismissed post
decisions.detail: QUOTE: **Deleted root post, town square read-only, or plugin-dismissed post** (`ServerErrors.DELETED_ROOT_POST_ERROR`, `TOWN_SQUARE_READ_ONLY_ERROR`, `PLUGIN_DISMISSED_POST_ERROR`): the post is removed with `removePost`. It is not kept as a failed post. | WHY: The answer names all three server errors and states the post is removed rather than kept as failed.

decisions.mark: states that a retry happens only when the user chooses "Try Again" on the failed post, and calls `retryFailedPost`
decisions.detail: QUOTE: The only caller of `retryFailedPost` is the failed-post bottom sheet's "Try Again" action (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx:48`). decisions.mark: concludes that `retryFailedPost` makes exactly one new attempt with no loop or backoff, and on failure marks the post failed again (or removes it for the same three errors)
decisions.detail: QUOTE: It calls `client.createPost` again. This is a fresh POST, which the server treats as a new post...
